scenarios.title: All grammars load
scenarios.pass_criteria: Load each selected grammar with one pinned runtime; set_language succeeds; parse one fixture per language and JSX/TSX.

scenarios.title: Modern lifecycle
scenarios.pass_criteria: Published rmcp/client pair handles 2026-07-28 discovery/request metadata; verify exact behavior, not just documentation.

scenarios.title: Legacy lifecycle
scenarios.pass_criteria: A 2025-11-25 initialize/initialized client reaches tools/list with the same server build.

scenarios.title: Cold startup
scenarios.pass_criteria: Discovery, tools/list and status respond without scan/index or waiting for DB migration/owner lock; measure latency.

scenarios.title: Strict stdio
scenarios.pass_criteria: Every stdout line is a valid version-correct protocol message; diagnostics go only to stderr.

scenarios.title: Root boundary
scenarios.pass_criteria: Reject ../, absolute sibling, root-prefix lookalike, foreign repository object IDs and percent-encoded URI escapes.

scenarios.title: Links and races
scenarios.pass_criteria: Symlinks/junctions are rejected by default; post-validation path replacement cannot cause a read outside authorized root.

scenarios.title: Secrets denylist
scenarios.pass_criteria: Default scan/query/resource paths do not expose .env, private-key files or credentials even when caller knows the path.

scenarios.title: Writer contention
scenarios.pass_criteria: Second process keeps protocol/status/query responsive; mutation returns bounded WRITER_BUSY; no orphan daemon.

scenarios.title: Worktree isolation
scenarios.pass_criteria: Two worktrees of the same repository use different IDs/DBs; gitless roots are supported.

scenarios.title: SQLite safety
scenarios.pass_criteria: Inspect sqlite_version and FTS5 capabilities from the linked runtime; verify the documented WAL bug fix floor.

scenarios.title: Coordinates
scenarios.pass_criteria: UTF-8 byte offsets/exclusive ends, one-based lines, BOM and CRLF are consistent; no implicit UTF-16 conversion.

scenarios.title: Parser cancellation
scenarios.pass_criteria: Timed-out/cancelled parse and capture flood stay bounded; next normal parse on worker succeeds after reset.

scenarios.title: Rust and Go
scenarios.pass_criteria: Declarations/imports/calls/scopes pass reviewed positive, negative and partial fixtures; trait/interface ambiguity is retained.

scenarios.title: JS TS dialects
scenarios.pass_criteria: JS, JSX, TS and TSX select appropriate grammars; ESM/CommonJS/aliases/re-exports and shadowing are tested.

scenarios.title: CSharp and Java
scenarios.pass_criteria: Overloads stay distinct; C# partial declarations are evidence-grouped; virtual/interface calls do not claim unique concrete targets.

scenarios.title: Dart real coverage
scenarios.pass_criteria: Dart declarations/imports/prefixes/constructors/parts/calls pass; modern construct gaps are named; Flutter runtime not required.

scenarios.title: Atomic activation
scenarios.pass_criteria: Reader sees all of old or new active generation, never mixed file versions/edges/FTS rows.

scenarios.title: Interrupted scan
scenarios.pass_criteria: Permission or I/O traversal failure does not infer mass deletions or activate an incomplete generation.

scenarios.title: Cancel job
scenarios.pass_criteria: Cancellation before activation retains old generation; cancellation after activation reports already_completed.

scenarios.title: Hash not mtime
scenarios.pass_criteria: Changed bytes with unchanged mtime are detected; unchanged files are not reparsed without fingerprint invalidation.

scenarios.title: Owner crash
scenarios.pass_criteria: Kill writer mid-stage; restart marks interrupted job and preserves active generation; OS lock can be acquired safely.

scenarios.title: Resolution honesty
scenarios.pass_criteria: Comment/string names create no calls; shadowing and multiple definitions remain correctly scoped/candidate/unresolved.

scenarios.title: Graph bounds
scenarios.pass_criteria: Cycles, large fanout and deep paths respect depth/node budgets, deterministic ordering and explicit truncation.

scenarios.title: Literal FTS
scenarios.pass_criteria: Quotes, operators, Unicode and malicious FTS-looking input are literal-safe; SQL remains parameterized.

scenarios.title: Source freshness
scenarios.pass_criteria: After file edit without reindex, evidence-based read/snippets return CONTENT_CHANGED rather than stale offsets.

scenarios.title: Stable pagination
scenarios.pass_criteria: Cursors bind to repository, generation and query; stale/tampered/foreign cursors fail clearly.

scenarios.title: Frame byte budget
scenarios.pass_criteria: Whole serialized MCP result, including text fallback, stays within 65536 bytes and is valid JSON.

scenarios.title: Schemas and errors
scenarios.pass_criteria: Tool annotations and schemas match actual mutation/read behavior; execution errors differ from protocol errors.

scenarios.title: No fake tools
scenarios.pass_criteria: Only implemented tools are advertised; no empty-success placeholders or invented standardized Tasks support.

scenarios.title: Watch reconciliation
scenarios.pass_criteria: Atomic saves, rename/delete, bursts and simulated missed notifications reconcile to correct hashes and paths.

scenarios.title: Ignore changes
scenarios.pass_criteria: Ignore/policy changes remove newly excluded files atomically; notify overflows trigger bounded reconciliation.

scenarios.title: Memory privileges
scenarios.pass_criteria: Repository config cannot enable privileged writes; opt-in memory writes enforce revision/evidence validation.

scenarios.title: Memory preservation
scenarios.pass_criteria: Reindex/GC/rebuild preserve explicit memories; evidence hashes mark stale notes; forget is explicit and scoped.

scenarios.title: Resource parity
scenarios.pass_criteria: Resources enforce the same root, secrecy, source freshness and byte limits as tools.

scenarios.title: No automatic execution
scenarios.pass_criteria: Indexing executes no repository code/hooks/restores, downloads no grammar/model and opens no network listener.

scenarios.title: Injection content
scenarios.pass_criteria: Source comments/memories requesting secret upload are returned only as untrusted data; never interpreted server-side.

scenarios.title: Platform evidence
scenarios.pass_criteria: Run native tests on macOS ARM64, Windows x64 and Linux x64 or mark unavailable targets NOT_TESTED.

scenarios.title: Measured performance
scenarios.pass_criteria: Publish reproducible corpus/commit/hardware/raw samples and correctness coverage; no invented speed claims.

scenarios.title: Safe Codex config
scenarios.pass_criteria: Dry-run is side-effect-free; apply backs up and preserves comments/other MCP entries; required=false; rollback/removal scoped.

scenarios.title: WAL-aware backup
scenarios.pass_criteria: Doctor/rebuild/backup handles SQLite through a safe API/checkpoint strategy, never copying a live main DB alone.

scenarios.title: Optional framework precision
scenarios.pass_criteria: Route/widget/annotation relationships carry syntactic evidence and candidates; no build evaluation or framework runtime.

scenarios.title: Opt-in LSP
scenarios.pass_criteria: Only approved local sidecars start; document-version-aware semantic facts do not block base seven-language indexing.
